title: A podcast host whose parts state quotas, limits and their absence
provenance: Synthetic system authored for this corpus (issue #2054, phase 2). Not derived from, or sanitized from, any real system: there is nothing to leak by omission.
notes: The case exists for issue #2054. It measures the assertion pass on the capacity-limits predicates, beside case 17. It states the shapes case 17 does not: a quota per show on the upload API, a stated absence of a rate limit on the public feed service, a stated absence of a concurrency limit on the stats importer, and a hedged size limit on one upload that must stay unknown. The transcoder states a concurrency limit. The denial-of-service must-find rests on the feed service's stated absence of a rate limit. The domain is podcast hosting, which no other case covers.
